name: Mackerel
description: Striped mackerel laid in rows like a fishmonger's print, each row swimming the opposite way to the one above.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-transform: translate(@r(-6, 6)%, @r(-10, 10)%) rotate(@r(-8, 8)deg) scaleX(@calc(1 - 2 * (@y % 2))); transform: translate(@r(-6, 6)%, @r(-10, 10)%) rotate(@r(-8, 8)deg) scaleX(@calc(1 - 2 * (@y % 2))); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -8%; top: 16%; width: 116%; height: 68%; -webkit-clip-path: @var(--fish); clip-path: @var(--fish); background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 12%, var(--color1) 12% 17%), @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 16%; top: 42%; width: 8%; height: 8%; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --fish: @shape(fish); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
